title: Repeat Count for Listing-Type Expiry under Seller Performance Standing
content:
**Rule.** The repeat count is taken over the last twelve whole calendar months: for a seller with a serious violation (intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity or review manipulation) recorded in that period it counts every violation of any type recorded in that period; for a seller with no serious violation but two or more listing-type violations recorded in that period it counts the listing-type violations of both types together; for every other seller it counts the violations of the more frequent listing type only.

The repeat count belongs to the expiry of listing-type violations — listing policy and restricted product violations — on a Seller Performance Standing record. Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the last twelve whole calendar months when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date.

## Which violations are counted

| Serious violation recorded in the period | Listing-type violations recorded in the period | The repeat count counts |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | any number | every violation of any type recorded in the period |
| none | two or more | listing policy and restricted product violations together |
| none | one or none | the violations of the more frequent listing type only |

## Hypothetical histories over the last twelve whole calendar months

| Violations recorded | Repeat count |
|---|---|
| one listing policy, one restricted product, one review manipulation | 3 — a serious violation is present, so all three count |
| one listing policy, one restricted product | 2 — no serious violation and two listing-type violations, counted together |
| two listing policy, one restricted product | 3 — counted together |
| one listing policy | 1 — the more frequent listing type, listing policy, has one |
| one intellectual property only | 1 — a serious violation is present, so every violation in the period counts |
| none | 0 |
